title: manas-cli sutra health integration
description:
## Parent

sutra/1 — prd for sutra watcher daemon

## What to build

Add sutra to the `manas health` command. Three changes in manas-cli:

1. Add `sutra_url` field to `ManasConfig` struct
2. Add `MANAS_SUTRA_URL` env var (default `http://127.0.0.1:3201`)
3. Add `("sutra", &config.sutra_url)` to the health check loop in `cmd/health.rs`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `ManasConfig` has `sutra_url` field
- [ ] `MANAS_SUTRA_URL` env var with `http://127.0.0.1:3201` default
- [ ] `manas health` output includes sutra line
- [ ] Shows "ok" when sutra daemon is running, "unreachable" when not

## Blocked by

- sutra/5 — REST endpoints + service install

manas health output includes sutra line
